Global Metadata
Genre: Hip-Hop / Trap with Conscious Rap and Cinematic influences; a viral, hook-driven Chinese rap critiquing the era of pervasive over-competition. Tempo: Driving, mid-fast trap feel (approx. 140-160 BPM with staggered half-time vocal delivery). Key: A minor.

Emotional Progression: Opens with a tense, oppressive, gray atmosphere mirroring the exhaustion of endless competition and self-destructive overwork. The verses deliver sharp, rhythmic, syllable-dense criticism that steadily accumulates frustration, while the chorus erupts into an anthemic, defiant, almost mocking release — a sticky viral hook that snaps against the grind. A middle bridge turns starkly bleak and reflective, exposing the emptiness beneath the rat race, before the final chorus explodes into full cathartic protest, ending on a fading, unresolved circular churn.

Sonics & Production Profile: Wide, hard-hitting production built on a heavy distorted 808 sub-bass anchor, crisp bright hi-hats, a punchy kick, and sharp snares/claps. Heavily compressed "wall-of-sound" chorus sections contrast sharply against tighter, more spacious, syllable-forward verses. The frequency spectrum is dominated by a rumbling low end and cutting, articulate upper mids that keep the rapid vocal flow intelligible.

Vocal Details
Vocal Style: Lead vocalist — a clear, resonant baritone with a slightly gritty, confrontational edge, voiced from inside the exhausting revolving grind. Verses are delivered with rapid, percussive, syllable-dense flow emphasizing rhythmic complexity and precise articulation, dissecting the futility of the competitive spiral. The chorus shifts into a melodic, chant-like, declarative delivery that is anthemic and dripping with sarcastic incredulity, designed to snap memorably at every bar.

Harmony/Backing Vocals: Layered backing vocals and ad-libs reinforce the chorus, creating a thick, slightly mocking call-and-response texture that amplifies the criticism. Stylistic pitch-correction (Auto-Tune) is applied, along with moderate compression, plate reverb, and spaced delay throws for virality.

Vocal FX: Heavier compression with pitch-shifted unison layers in the chorus; tighter, drier treatment in the verses to preserve articulation. Vocal chops and glitch effects are sprinkled throughout for a modern, viral, electronic edge.

Arrangement
Intro: A tense, ominous atmosphere opens with atmospheric synth pads and a distant, rhythmic clock-tick / keyboard-clacking motif, establishing the oppressive churn. A riser sweeps up on the count-in.

Hook 1 (Chorus): The beat drops at full force — the 808 sub-bass anchors while the trap kit layers a punchy kick, sharp snares/claps on beats 2 and 4, and rapid rolling triplet hi-hat patterns. The melodic, defiant chorus rides over a dark, looping minor-key synth melody.

Verse 1: Instrumentation pulls back slightly; hi-hats drive rapid syncopation while the 808 sustains. The vocal locks into a tight percussive flow. Bell-like synth accents mark structural changes.

Verse 2: Industrial-tinged percussion and a harder-hitting snare layer intensify the drive as the criticism sharpens. Ad-libs and vocal chops decorate the gaps, panned wide across the stereo field.

Bridge: A stark textural shift — the drums strip to a minimal kick pulse, the synth melody thins to a cold, bleak minor motif, and the lead vocal delivers a somber, reflective section voicing the emptiness and insomnia of the grind.

Final Chorus: The full arrangement crashes back at maximum intensity — dense compression, layered gang-style backing vocals, crash cymbals, and anthemic doubling. Reverse cymbal swells and white-noise risers rocket the track to its peak.

Outro: The energy collapses into a stuttering, slowly decaying 808 and a fading synth loop, the clock-tick motif returning, leaving an unresolved, circular sense of the churning continuing — the fool's perpetual treadmill.

[Intro]
（时钟滴答声，脚步急促，键盘敲击声在雾中回响）
又一天 天没亮就睁眼
又一个 不敢停的白天

[Hook 1]
全都在卷！卷！卷！
比谁熬得晚 比谁死得惨
工资没涨 身体先垮
这个局 到底图个啥？
比加班 比加班 比谁更下贱
把命 都押在那张工牌上面！

[Verse 1]
地铁里 挤满麻木的脸
深夜的 灯还亮在窗前
我奋斗 不是为了当个螺丝
可现实 逼我学会低头认错
你加班 我加班 卷成一根麻花
你内耗 我内耗 熬成一肚子火
拼了命 去追那条 看不见的线
回头才发现 我们都在原地 打转

[Verse 2]
KPI 一个 比一个 荒唐
小组长 天天 画着大饼讲
你改我 我改你 改到天亮
这个"优化" 那个"升级" 全是假象
论文要卷 简历要彩 副业要开
结果呢 兜里还是 一块两块
所有的卷 卷不出 一点点希望
只卷出 我们 渐渐变冷的心肠

[Bridge]
（伴奏骤减，只剩心跳与稀疏键盘）
我问自己 这么拼 到底 为了谁
为了 一套房 为了 一个户口本？
把最好的年华 都烧成 灰
换来的 只有 一身疲惫
和一夜一夜 失眠的 黑

[Final Chorus]
全都在卷！卷！卷！（吼出）
可我不想 再当 陪跑的蠢蛋！
我要快活 我要健康 我要天空蓝
别再用 大饼 喂饱我的 贪念
停下来！醒过来！别再 自我摧残！
这条 卷死人的路 我TM 不干了！

[Outro]
（808衰减，时钟再次滴答，雾中脚步声远去）
卷吧 卷吧 卷吧...
反正 谁也 逃不掉
活着 就是 一场 漫长的
内卷 循环 的 牢...
